education.title: Western University
education.description: Currently pursuing an Honors Specialization in Computer Science, with coursework covering software engineering, object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, computer organization and architecture, theoretical computer science, and data science. My studies have given me experience developing software in Java, Python, and C, as well as collaborating on software engineering projects.

The challenge involved scoring points by placing cones on poles of different heights and parking in designated areas during matches. posts.text: I recently completed freeCodeCamp's Responsive Web Design certification! The course helped me learn a lot about HTML, CSS and responsive design. I've been applying all those skills by building several front-end web projects from scratch, most notably my project portfolio. I'm very excited to have reached a working version featuring my most interesting projects, and luckily, I found a perfect matching domain and bought it!
